3. The general objects for which th: constituted are hereby declared to be—

(a)
to  provide  medical  aid  and  food  to  the  poor,  the
destitute and the sick;

(b)
to conduct special services for needy school children
and to offer assistance by way of scholarships, library
facilities and other necessary support for students;

(c)
to conduct classes for the students sitting for Year
Five  Scholarship,  GCE  (O/L)  and  GCE  (A/L)
examinations  by  experts  in  the  particular  field  of
education;

(d)
to  support  and  encourage  the  service  facilities
rendered by senior citizens organizations;

(e)
to work for the development of pre-schools for the
early childhood development of needy children;

(f)
to give aid by way of scholarships to any officer or
servant engaged in the furtherance of the objects of
the  Corporation;

(g)
to promote co-operation and friendship with similar
institutions within and outside Sri Lanka;

(h)
to organize employees of small and medium scale
industries and enterprises and working towards their
future  advancement;

(i)
to initiate and implement economic, social, cultural
and  environmental  development  activities  in
Sri Lanka and providing guidance necessary for it;

(j)
to  combat  waste  and  corruption  and  utilize  all
resources  belonging  to  our  community  in  a  very
useful manner;
